fix: accept expect.soft.poll as a valid assertion (#524)

Playwright 1.61 supports soft polling assertions. Recognize
expect.soft.poll(...) as a valid expect chain and count it as an
assertion, while still rejecting unsupported orders such as
expect.poll.soft.
